p: MY BISPRO (mybispro/ in bravo-agency-app) is the smallest of the four agency apps: 50,880 hand-written Dart lines in 247 files, 16 feature folders, for Sharia credit-marketing staff. It shares the monorepo, the CI setup and seven shared packages with GENFI, SQUARE and MyShaf. The shared findings on Genfi mobile app assessment and Square mobile app assessment apply here. This page lists what MY BISPRO adds, compared with the DK Jago app in the same way.

li.p: Every pipeline is red. The last five runs of the trunk, SIT and prod workflows all failed. The prod pipeline last ran on 19 Jun 2026 and failed on the Datadog symbol upload before the Play upload step. The UAT workflow has never run. No tag since v1.8.0-rc.4-mybispro (19 Jun 2026). One commit touched mybispro/ in the last 90 days.

Errors go nowhere.DatadogLog.e creates a Datadog logger named after the error and never writes to it. 108 call sites and the Riverpod provider observer send nothing. There is no Crashlytics, no analytics event, no user id. Datadog RUM is configured in code, but no RUM application exists for MY BISPRO and no session was recorded in the last 30 days. The app is unmonitored.
A config name mismatch keeps root detection always on. CI passes FEATURE_ENABLE_JAILBREAK_DETECTION, the code reads FEATURE_JAILBREAK_DETECTION with default true. It cannot be switched off from CI.
Certificate pinning only in prod. DEV, SIT and UAT builds do not receive SHA_256_FINGERPRINT. The debug build type signs with the release keystore.
Prod environment has no protection rule (verified). All four sharia_*_mybispro environments return zero rules from the API. The only gate is the manual-approval action, 2 of 9 named people.

Architecture is the same gap as GENFI, smaller. No domain layer. 49 of 68 screens import shared_data packages directly. 61 StateNotifier controllers, 70 static final providers. Eight two-way feature import pairs, common imports loansimulation, and main.dart → app.dart → app_controller.dart → main.dart is an import cycle.
Tests are widget tests only. 57 files, 223 testWidgets, 0 test(, 0 controller tests, 0 goldens, no coverage threshold. Controllers are mocked in the widget tests, so the rules in them are untested.
A placeholder reaches production. The credit-analyst note in the edit-loan form is the l10n string dummyCreditAnalystNote.
Decision already made for the monorepo: keep Riverpod, copy Jago's layers, ports and wrapper, not its bloc library.

p: All findings come from reading source and CI files at the revision above, the GitHub REST API (environments, workflow runs, job and step conclusions, no logs) and Datadog RUM. td.p: Melos workspace, feature and shared packages, thin *_api contracts.

One package with 16 feature folders under lib/features. 399 package imports between features, 8 two-way pairs (agent ↔ inputprospect, common ↔ loansimulation, mkyc ↔ prospectlist and five more). common is not a leaf. lib/app imports features in 12 places. (shared) The melos mybispro category and the PR path filter list shared_data/document and sso, which the app does not depend on.
Feature boundaries exist only by folder. Fix the category and filter now (S); feature packages come with the shared repo-layout plan.
S now, L with the shared plan
data → domain ← presentation. Domain is pure Dart.

Screen → controller (StateNotifier) → shared_data repository → HttpClient. No domain folder anywhere. 47 files read a repository provider directly (87 call sites). 49 of 68 screens import a shared_data package. The shared_data models are already mapped from the network DTOs, which is a good base.
Rules sit in controllers and 1,200-line screens.

Riverpod 2.6 StateNotifier: 61 controllers, 70 static final providers, 1 global StateProvider, NavigationService.instance singleton. ref.watch on onPressed lines: 4. AppController.onAppLoaded() is called from App.build on every build and again from AppScreen.initState.
Keep Riverpod. Move to Notifier. Remove the double onAppLoaded.
injectable + get_it, wiring only in the app layer.

ProviderScope with 4 overrides in main.dart. The auth client is chosen at start-up by the Remote Config flag FEATURE_KEYCLOAK_MANAGE_TOKEN and swapped at runtime with container.updateOverrides when the flag changes, after logging the user out of the other Keycloak repository. No interfaces: repositories are concrete, the only abstraction is core.HttpClient.
Riverpod is fine as DI. Ports are missing. The runtime swap is an escape hatch that should go when the network chain lands.
AnalyticsPlatform interface, fan-out to Datadog, Firebase, CleverTap, typed events.

None. No firebase_analytics, no event call, no user id, no custom RUM action. Views would come from the DatadogNavigationObserver on the GoRouter, but most screens are pushed with plain Navigator, so view coverage is unknown.
Decide what MY BISPRO should measure. Then the shared analytics port.
Monitoring fans out to Crashlytics and Datadog. PII sanitiser.

DatadogLog.e calls createLogger(name: e.toString()) and never .error(). 108 call sites and the provider observer report nothing. No Crashlytics. Datadog RUM native crash reporting is on, but no RUM application exists. Consent hard-coded granted. No PII sanitiser.
Fix DatadogLog.e once in core (same bug on GENFI and SQUARE), create the RUM application, decide on Crashlytics.

RemoteConfig freezed model with 6 keys: 1 flag (FEATURE_KEYCLOAK_MANAGE_TOKEN) and 5 numbers (agent period, schedule, maintain threshold, latest and minimum app version for the update prompt). Live updates through onConfigUpdated. One raw getBool in main.dart. 21 compile-time dart-defines, one of them misnamed in CI.
Small and clean. Join the shared catalogue; fix the CI name.
dio adapter behind a client interface, typed exceptions.

core.HttpClient (dio, 30 s timeouts) behind one of two Keycloak decorators. Both refresh before every call and clear the session on 401. No retry interceptor, no request id header, no dio tracing for RUM. retry is used only for the FCM token. Login is a Keycloak webview. (shared) The two decorators are two of the six near-identical auth clients.
Same chain as the other apps.
Everspin RASP, CodeMix, build registration, device fingerprint, screen-capture guard, pinning.

Pinning only when SHA_256_FINGERPRINT is passed, only prod passes it. Root detection on, cannot be turned off from CI (name mismatch). No Play Integrity. --obfuscate --split-debug-info in CI, no explicit minifyEnabled, no proguard-rules.pro. allowBackup false, no cleartext. Debug build type signed with the release keystore. FEATURE_ENABLE_PROXY reaches prod from a variable. No screen-capture guard. Tokens in secure storage. A WhatsApp link carries the customer's mobile number.
Pin everywhere, fix the flag name, keep debug off the release key, drop the prod proxy switch. RASP with the other repos.
ui_theme only (119 files). BfiColors 731 uses, raw colours 47 sites. No ds_* git package.
The cleanest of the four apps. Keep it that way through the shared design-system plan.
5,288 test files, coverage gate on changed files, Appium end-to-end.

57 widget test files, 223 testWidgets, 0 test(, 0 controller tests, 0 goldens, no integration tests. Controllers mocked with mocktail. Template widget_test.dart with an empty main(). Coverage computed, never gated. No randomisation.
Controller tests for the three rule-heavy features first. Coverage gate on changed files.

(shared) Root strict_lint.yaml with 6 rules downgraded to ignore, including depend_on_referenced_packages. very_good_analysis is a dev dependency but not the rule set. flutter analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings, format check, pubghost. p: lib/app/utils/datadog_log.dart is the same file as in GENFI and SQUARE. DatadogLog.e(e, st) builds a DatadogLoggerConfiguration(name: e.toString()), calls createLogger, and returns. The stack trace is unused. guardLog wraps 108 calls with it, and DatadogLogProviderObserver reports every AsyncError from every provider through it. Nothing reaches Datadog Logs. Because MY BISPRO has no Crashlytics either, a handled error in this app is invisible. The fix is one method in core, shared by all four apps, and a RUM application for MY BISPRO so the SDK has somewhere to send.

h3: 2. Config and build mistakes that cost nothing to fix

li.p: FEATURE_ENABLE_JAILBREAK_DETECTION (CI) vs FEATURE_JAILBREAK_DETECTION (code). Root detection is always on. Either is fine, but the define is dead.
google-services Gradle plugin declared in settings.gradle, never applied. Firebase runs from dart-defines only. Delete the declaration or the confusion stays.
gradle.properties suppresses "unsupported compileSdk 35" while compileSdk is 36.
appAuthRedirectScheme placeholders per flavour, but flutter_appauth is not a dependency.
test/src/widget_test.dart is the Flutter template with an empty main().
The trunk DEV build builds an APK and throws it away. Either distribute it or stop building it.

p: inputprospect is 11,601 lines in 29 files, a quarter of the app. It is the pilot feature for Phase 7. The router declares 9 routes. Most screens are pushed with Navigator, so typed routes per feature come with the layering work.

li.p: dummyCreditAnalystNote ("dummy credit analyst note") is set as the credit-analyst note by edit_loan_form_controller.dart:55 and shown by the form. Check what the backend receives.

create_agent_model.dart carries a TODO "remove this when create agent API is ready". upload_image_field.dart:182 has "hit upload service" with the upload not wired. Check whether these screens are live.
FirebaseMessaging.requestPermission() runs in main before any UI, so iOS asks for push permission on first launch with no context.
MyBisProSharedPreferences.deleteAllData() clears the whole SharedPreferences store.
Older majors: share_plus 7, mime 1.0, freezed 2.5, geolocator 13, go_router 14, Riverpod 2.6. The git dependency flutter_jailbreak_detection is pinned by SHA to bfi-flutter-packages.
The GitHub API lists an active workflow mybispro-pr-pipeline.yml whose file no longer exists on master. Some run history sits under renamed files.
The MyShaf route inside this app (myShafRoute) is a screen, not the MyShaf app.

p: Shared with the monorepo (secret-printing workflows, keystore artifact, BRAVO_GCP_SA_KEY in 51 repos, prod builds without environment rules): see Genfi mobile app assessment and Agency phase 0: Close the leak. Specific to MY BISPRO:

li.p: sharia_prod_mybispro has no protection rule (verified 26 Oct 2026). Required reviewers are not available on the Team plan for private repos, so limit the environment to release refs and keep the approval step, as the shared Phase 0 page says.
DEV, SIT and UAT builds are unpinned. Only the prod workflow passes SHA_256_FINGERPRINT.
The debug build type uses the release signing config (build.gradle:122-128). A debug build from any laptop with the keystore is a release-signed binary.
FEATURE_ENABLE_PROXY enters prod builds from a repository variable. When on, it also switches off Datadog HTTP tracking.

Secrets interpolated into run: lines in all four workflows (trunk 81-88, SIT 57-70 and 137-164, UAT the same, prod 103-117 and 226-254). CLIENT_SECRET for Keycloak is among them and is compiled into the binary as a dart-define.
No permissions: block in any workflow, so every job runs with the default token.
Root detection cannot be switched off (name mismatch). This is safe but means a false positive on a staff device blocks the user until a code change.
The Keycloak login is an in-app webview (keycloak depends on webview_flutter), not the system browser. Inferred from the dependency, not traced further.

p: MY BISPRO does not get thirteen plan pages of its own. It is small, and most of the work is shared. The split:

li.p: Shared, done once for the monorepo: security, CI/CD, networking, lint, repo layout, design system, dependency injection, Riverpod 3. Under Agency apps roadmap: shared phases, MY BISPRO is a row in every phase table.

MY BISPRO rows in the GENFI plan pages where the finding is identical: GENFI plan 03: Logging and crashes (the DatadogLog.e fix is one change in core), GENFI plan 10: Feature flags (one catalogue), GENFI plan 12: Design system.

MY BISPRO only: the per-app phases below. They follow the same impact classes as GENFI roadmap: step by step (A no app change, B same behaviour, C behind a switch flag, D approved delta, E backend-coupled).

td.p: Repair the trunk build (Java 17, SDK 36) and the SIT and prod pipelines so one run is green. Delete the Crashlytics symbol step. Move the Play upload before the Datadog symbol upload.
Limit sharia_prod_mybispro to release refs. Pin actions by SHA, add permissions:, move secrets to env:.
Fix the melos category and PR path filter (drop document, sso), trigger trunk on shared-package changes.
Create the MY BISPRO RUM application and pass its id. Fix DatadogLog.e in core.
Controller tests for inputprospect, editloan and maintainagent against today's behaviour. Coverage gate on changed files.

Approved deltas, one per release: remove dummyCreditAnalystNote, fix the jailbreak define name, pin SIT and UAT, debug build off the release key, drop the prod proxy variable, move the push-permission prompt behind a screen.
Network chain behind useInterceptorClient: the two Keycloak decorators become the shared chain. Remove the runtime updateOverrides swap.
Pilot: inputprospect through the parity loop (ledger, flag useNewInputProspectFlow, domain for the prospect and financing rules, Notifiers, cohort 20% → 100%, flip, delete).
Other features through the same loop: maintainagent, editloan, agent, mkyc, then class B conversions for the rest. Break the 8 two-way pairs and the main.dart cycle on the way.

p: Suggested epic names: "[Tech x DK] MY BISPRO Improvement - Approved deltas", "- Pilot: input prospect", "- Remaining features". The shared phases use the epics on the shared pages.
